amenitiesDescription: The rooftop features a residents-only restaurant and bar by a curated hospitality operator, an outdoor yoga terrace, and a resort-style pool with lounge seating and cabana areas. The fitness center includes cardio, strength, and dedicated studio spaces. Curated social programming — consistent with the NoMad brand's emphasis on cultural community — includes rotating pop-ups, screenings, and events that activate the building's common spaces year-round. The amenity package appeals equally to full-time residents and owners participating in the short-term rental program.
description: NoMad's first-ever residential tower — 329 fully furnished homes in the heart of Wynwood. Delivered 2026 by Related Group, Tricap, and Sydell Group. Designed by Arquitectonica with interiors by DesignAgency.

signals.title: NoMad — hospitality's most design-credible boutique brand
signals.body: NoMad Hotels (Major Food Group) operates in NYC, LA, London, and Las Vegas. Their design ethos — art, culture, gastronomy — maps precisely onto Wynwood's identity. This is the right brand for this neighborhood in a way that a traditional hotel brand is not.

signals.title: Wynwood — Miami's fastest-appreciating arts district
signals.body: Wynwood has transformed from a warehouse district into Miami's most visited arts destination. Goldman Properties, Related, and institutional capital have all entered the market. NoMad Residences is the first major branded residential tower in the neighborhood.

signals.title: Top short-term rental yield in Miami
signals.body: Wynwood's Art Basel adjacency, street art culture, and restaurant/nightlife density create consistently high short-term rental demand. Miami's broader STR market has a Wynwood occupancy premium vs. comparable neighborhoods.

investmentIntelligence.thesis: NoMad Wynwood is the arts-district investment thesis: buy the neighborhood's first institutional-quality branded anchor, before the corridor completes its gentrification cycle. NYC's Meatpacking District, LA's Arts District, and London's Shoreditch all followed the same path — the first branded hospitality/residential anchor always captures the most appreciation. Wynwood is 3–5 years into that cycle. At $1,200+/sqft with 6–9% gross yield potential and NoMad's design credibility, the risk/return profile is asymmetric.

investmentThesis: A delivered, closing-now branded residence in one of Miami's strongest short-term rental submarkets. Of 329 residences, only 9 remain — penthouses and upper-floor units ranging from $670,900 to $1.5M. The fully furnished turnkey product combined with Wynwood's nightly rental demand makes this one of the most compelling income-generating branded residences in the Miami pipeline, and the brand's first residential extension means early-buyer pricing relative to where NoMad will reset on its next project. For buyers seeking yield-bearing branded inventory in a creative-district address, the closing window represents one of the last opportunities to acquire at developer pricing.
name: NoMad Residences Wynwood
projectFeatures: 329 fully furnished residences curated by NoMad and DesignAgency
9-story building designed by Arquitectonica on a 1.25-acre site
9+ foot ceilings with floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors
Bosch appliances with Italian-designed cabinetry and stone countertops
In-residence washer/dryer and smart climate control
Rooftop NoMad Restaurant and Bar with dedicated elevator
Casa Tua Cucina — 13,000 SF Italian eatery on the ground floor
Full-service rooftop pool, sun deck, and cabanas
Fitness and wellness center with outdoor fitness lawns
Library, co-working spaces, outdoor cinema, and grilling area
24-hour concierge, valet parking, and in-building garage
Museum-quality curated artwork from the Jorge M. Pérez Collection
EV charging stations, bicycle storage, and private residential storage
residenceContent: The first-ever residential concept by the NoMad Hotels brand. Every residence arrives fully furnished and turnkey, styled to reflect NoMad's signature blend of individual character and hotel-level comfort. Interiors by DesignAgency draw on the NoMad aesthetic — warm woods, curated textiles, and layered lighting that feel collected rather than decorated. Artwork from the Jorge M. Pérez Collection runs through the building's common spaces, bringing genuine cultural provenance into the residential experience. Boutique finishes, bespoke millwork, and a level of furnishing detail uncommon at this price point throughout.
residenceFeatures: Fully furnished and creatively curated by NoMad and DesignAgency
